ObjectName.value: Coronavirus. SARS-CoV-2

Categories.value: Self-published work|2021 illustrations|Illustrations by Commons users|Science images with transparent background|Pictures of the Year/2021 (finalist)|Molecular models of SARS-CoV-2 virions

ImageDescription.value:
Scientifically accurate atomic model of the external structure of the Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome CoronaVirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), a strain (genetic variant) of the coronavirus that caused coronavirus disease (COVID-19), first identified in Wuhan, China, during December 2019

Each separate locus (amorphous blob) is a molecule of:

 
cobalt: membrane
 
crimson: E protein
 
green: M protein
 
orange: glucose (glycan)
 
turquoise: S (spike) glycoprotein
